name: Comic Con Wales
blurb: Monopoly Events' Welsh pop culture convention at ICC Wales in Newport, with film, TV and gaming guests.
notes: The page's meta description calls these 'biannual shows' but the visible body copy says 'every year' / 'attracting over ten thousand fans annually', and only one 2027 date is published anywhere on the site, so a single annual edition was recorded rather than guessing a second 2026/2027 date. The guests page shows only a single 'TBC' placeholder tile with no names - guests is 'none-yet'. 'In previous years' text namedrops John Cena, Martin Kove, Michael Rooker, Ian Somerhalder and Ioan Gruffudd, but that is marketing copy about past shows, not a confirmed 2027 lineup. Organizer Monopoly Events confirmed by the shared Wix template/footer and the seed note.
